name: universal-skill-hub
description: Central registry of canonical, cross-platform Agent Skills with routing, safety, and drift verification.

scripts.installer-dry-run-smoke: node scripts/install-skills.mjs --platform claude-code --scope project --project-root . && node scripts/install-skills.mjs --platform codex --scope project --project-root .
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run validate && npm run registry-consistency && npm run render-adapters && git diff --exit-code -- adapters/codex adapters/claude-code adapters/cursor adapters/opencode && npm run check-drift && npm run bundle:claude-ai && npm run bundle:openai && npm run installer-dry-run-smoke
